svg.title: Non-mechanical back and neck pain: a nerve squeezed at the side (radiculopathy) or in the centre (lumbar stenosis, cauda equina syndrome, cervical myelopathy), or everything else flagged by red flags (inflammatory, fracture, infection or neoplasm); each column gives presentation, investigations and treatment
